title: On Spectral Gaps of Random Matrices
abstract: We prove that Wigner matrices with sub-gaussian entries have spectral gap at least c/n with high probability.

blocks.label: def:gap
blocks.name: spectral gap
blocks.clean_text: Let M be an n x n real symmetric random matrix with eigenvalues L1 >= L2 >= ... >= Ln. The spectral gap of M is defined as gap(M) := L1 - L2.

assumptions.text: M is an n x n real symmetric random matrix

blocks.label: thm:main
blocks.name: Main Theorem
blocks.clean_text: Let M be an n x n Wigner matrix with sub-gaussian entries. Assume n >= n0 for some absolute constant n0. Then gap(M) >= c/n with probability at least 1 - e^{-n}, where c > 0 is an absolute constant.

assumptions.text: M is an n x n Wigner matrix with sub-gaussian entries
n >= n0 for some absolute constant n0

conclusions.text: gap(M) >= c/n with probability at least 1 - e^{-n}

blocks.label: lem:trace
blocks.clean_text: For any n x n real symmetric matrix A, sum of lambda_i^2 = tr(A^2).

assumptions.text: A is an n x n real symmetric matrix

Assume for contradiction that $\mathrm{gap}(M) < c/n$. By Definition~\ref{def:gap}, ...

steps.text: Assume for contradiction that gap(M) < c/n.
Construct a perturbation matrix P using the spectral gap definition.
steps.prove: gap of M+P can be controlled

sub_steps.text: By Definition D1, gap(M) = L1 - L2.
Construct P with entries bounded by c/(2n).

steps.text: Apply the trace identity to M+P to bound the eigenvalue sum.
steps.prove: sum of eigenvalues squared of M+P <= tr((M+P)^2)

steps.text: The trace bound contradicts the assumption gap(M) < c/n.
steps.prove: contradiction obtained, therefore gap(M) >= c/n. QED.
